product.name: Generator Rentals
product.description: Rental service providing diesel generators ranging from small to multi-megawatt capacities for temporary power supply in various settings.

product.name: Cooling Solutions
product.description: Rental of HVAC and temperature control equipment including air handling units and chillers for maintaining optimal climate conditions.

product.name: Electrical and Construction Services
product.description: Comprehensive electrical maintenance, construction project management, and turnkey power plant solutions tailored to industrial and commercial needs.

product.name: Event Solutions
product.description: Integrated event support including power rentals, cooling systems, tents, cabins, and consultation services for various event types.

product.name: Solar Fold PV System
product.description: Modular solar energy system designed for efficient, scalable power generation in industrial and remote site applications.

product.name: Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)
product.description: Modular battery storage units that store excess energy for use during peak demand, enhancing grid stability and reducing costs.
